description: Use when someone shows you a proof, certificate or token and you want to check it before relying on it, or you need the facts about any asset on Bitcoin. Free, no API key. For agent names, verify_agent gives a clearer identity verdict. Looks up any token on Bitcoin by asset name (e.g. A12044707814007245827 or GAMESOFTRUMP). For proofs made on Prove It Onchain it returns the claim, the pass/fail checks (exists, supply is 1, locked, claim record reachable and matching its on-chain hash), owner, creation tx, the certificate URL and the record URL. For other assets it returns their facts (owner, supply, divisibility, lock status) without proof checks. Read-only.
name: verify
title: Verify an asset
